(TradingView) ![Image 2: Stephen Alpher](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2F9c64385838f127845d0783e09a18548c2b886ce2-512x512.png%3Fw%3D64%26h%3D64%26fit%3Dcrop%26crop%3Dfocalpoint%26auto%3Dformat&w=96&q=75) ## Fed's Beige Book offers hint of more good news on inflation “Compared with the last reporting period, price growth was the same or slower in all Districts,” according to the National Summary of the Federal Reserve’s just-released [Beige Book](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/beigebook202607-summary.htm). Combined with soft inflation reports from the past two days and dovish comments from New York Fed President John Williams, the news would appear to take any chance of a July rate hike off the table.
